evidence.title: Pricing page generator: React, Vue, Shadcn UI & Tailwind CSS | Beautiful & performant Next.js apps deployed in minutes

name: Pricing page generator
summary: Configurator that generates pricing page code for Shadcn UI, Radix UI, Tailwind CSS, Next.js/Shipixen or Vue projects.
description: A pricing page generator: set a page description, optional banner text and up to three pricing tiers (name, description, price, features, monthly or annually), preview one-, two- and three-tier examples live, then copy the code. Export variants: React/Next.js + Shadcn UI, React/Next.js + Radix UI, React/Next.js + Tailwind CSS, Next.js/Shipixen and Vue + Tailwind CSS (options or composition API); responsive with dark mode included.
contains: pricing tiers: up to three, each with name, description, price and features
live demos of one-, two- and three-tier pricing pages
export: React/Next.js + Shadcn UI, Radix UI or Tailwind CSS
export: Next.js/Shipixen boilerplate or Vue + Tailwind CSS
